nodes.label: FunkMaxExport
nodes.rationale: 3ds Max tool for LGMD/LGMM weapon editing, vhot preservation, and custom static exports.

nodes.label: LGMD (Static Object Model)
nodes.rationale: Dark Engine format for rigid sub-objects used for guns and world objects.

nodes.label: LGMM (Skinned AI Mesh)
nodes.rationale: Dark Engine format for bone-weighted meshes used for melee weapons and characters.

nodes.label: VHot (Virtual Hotspot)
nodes.rationale: Attachment points in models used for muzzle flashes, shell ejection, and VR pivots.

nodes.label: Funk Direct
nodes.rationale: Topology-preserving vertex patch path that preserves original LGMD chunks while allowing vertex movement.

nodes.label: Funk Mesh
nodes.rationale: Constrained topology tier allowing face deletion and subobject emptying while remapping BSP nodes.

nodes.label: Funk Custom
nodes.rationale: Path for emitting new static LGMD assets from Max mesh groups with rebuilt materials.

nodes.label: Funk Extract
nodes.rationale: Isolates named source subobjects to create standalone models while preserving light/normal records.

nodes.label: PointRig Animation System
nodes.rationale: Runtime Squirrel-driven system that interpolates joint rotations/positions for LGMD sub-objects.
